messages.subject: package recommenderlab unavailable
parts:
Hi

Nice project ! But I really need the recommenderlab package for my project, which is currently not available. Can you give me an update on this one? 

Many thanks !

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: package recommenderlab unavailable
parts:
I ran a new build of recommenderlab against the latest version of Renjin, and it does look like some issues have been resolved:
http://packages.renjin.org/package/org.renjin.cran/recommenderlab/0.2-1/build/3

But mostly the package still seems non-functional due to problems with Renjin's S4 implementation and some obscure issues with the compiled Matrix code. 

All I can say at this point is that both of the areas are under active development funded by our Horizon 2020 project. 

If you're interested in contributing to Renjin with an eye towards running these packages, pull requests are welcome. We also offer commercial support which can included focused development on Renjin for a specific package on an hourly basis.

Best,
Alex
